A meaningful use of event combination requires that certain configuration values of in-
dividual events or related properties have the same configured values. In particular the
diagnostic indicator configuration for combined events requires this. These consistent
settings is enforced by constraints in the DEXT.
In table [SWS_DM_01977] the following logical operators are used:
• ! = logical negation (NOT)
•
|
= logical bitwise OR-operation
• & logical bitwise AND-operation
